f03.chart.dd_axis: Y-axis: how far equity sits below its previous peak (%); 0 means a new high.
f03.chart.eq_axis: Y-axis: cumulative return since the start (%), starting at 0. Solid line = strategy, dashed line = buy-and-hold benchmark.
f03.heat.note: Unit: %. Red = up month, green = down month (A-share convention); darker means a larger move. Every cell shows its number and losses carry a minus sign, so colour is not needed to read it. The last column is the full year.
f03.kline.note: The y-axis is price. Red candles closed above the open, green candles below it (A-share convention). Buys are upward arrows under the bar (B) and sells are downward arrows above it (S); the shape and letter tell them apart without colour.
f03.market.heat_note: Red = up, green = down (A-share convention, the reverse of Western charts); darker means a larger move. Every tile shows the signed change, so colour is not needed to read it. n = number of stocks in the sector.
f03.replay.hint: The composite score combines CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown and consistency into one number used only for ranking. Everything in this table is synthetic demo data; do not use it to pick a strategy.
